name: arXiv API
licence_note: Metadata CC0; max one request every 3 s
coverage_note: AI research papers in cs.AI, cs.CL, cs.LG and cs.CV. Measures research activity, not jobs.

name: GitHub repositories
coverage_note: Public repositories tagged with topics. Untagged repos are invisible. Tech-heavy.

name: Hacker News stories
coverage_note: Stories with 100+ points. Tech-heavy, English-language, US-centric audience.

name: Hacker News "Who is hiring?"
coverage_note: Monthly hiring thread. Tech roles only, mostly US/EU and remote. Used as evidence for tech skills only.

name: DOSM Job Market Insights
coverage_note: Online job ads from major private recruitment platforms only; not every Malaysian vacancy. Demand is measured per occupation and translated to skills.
